يستجوبا (form X)
# يَسْتَجْوِبَا (yastajwibā) /jas.tad͡ʒ.wi.baː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
# يُسْتَجْوَبَا (yustajwabā) /jus.tad͡ʒ.wa.baː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
